intro.name: The trial
intro.text: The village holds a contest of balance, grappling, footwork, and controlled unarmed technique. No striking vulnerable areas is permitted.

choices.label: Judge by grace, restraint, and teaching.

a1.text: The smallest competitor redirects the strongest without hurting (strongest.him/her), winning the tournament and an astonished silence.

p1.text: A judge from the other community praises the winning rival despite pressure from (judge.his/her) own supporters. The crowd slowly applauds.
